scoring_justification: Proprietary COMPASS force field used in paper prevents absolute value comparison; basic sanity checks (positive moduli, reasonable ranges) are used.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed mechanical moduli, coefficient of friction, and abrasion rate for each of the four composites: pristine, COOCH3, OH, COOH. The checker will verify basic sanity (all moduli positive, G_H in (0.1,10) GPa, COF in (0,1)) and consistency with the simulation protocol.

output_contract.notes: The task uses a public open-source force field instead of the proprietary COMPASS force field; therefore absolute numerical values may differ from the paper. All construction parameters (cell sizes, functionalization details, NBR chain length and numbers, simulation durations) are provided in the instruction.

steps.description: Verify that all mechanical moduli are positive, G_H in (0.1,10) GPa, COF in (0,1), and AR in (0,100) percent. No ordering checks.
